definition.simple: When a living thing creates a baby all by itself, without needing a partner.
definition.academic: A mode of reproduction by which offspring arise from a single organism, and inherit the genes of that parent only.

examples: A potato growing a new plant from its 'eyes'.

common_misconceptions: Students often think all plants grow from seeds.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to remember how their mom grows mint or money plant at home.
